target.statement: QaDS achieves 31.3% average accuracy on Sbase-69K with LLaMA-2, outperforming other selection strategies.
target.table_ref: Table 3, row 'QaDS', column 'All' under 'LLaMA-2 base model'
target.dataset: Sbase-69K (a subset of 69K samples from 10 datasets: AQuA-RAT, Camel-Math, College-Math, GSM8K, GSM8K-RFT, MATH, Number-Comparison, TheoremQA, CoT, Evol-Instruct-v2)

compute.basis: Fine-tuning a 7B model on 69K samples for 3 epochs requires ~72 GPU-hours on 4 A100s (estimated from typical throughput), which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop; data selection and quality scoring add further overhead.

blockers: Requires fine-tuning a 7B LLM (LLaMA-2) on 69K samples for 3 epochs
Needs 4 NVIDIA A100 GPUs (80GB each) for training
Quality scoring requires running inference on many samples with a 7B model
Data selection involves training a pre-experienced model and computing embeddings
title: Exploring the Mystery of Influential Data for Mathematical Reasoning
